description: Rung 2 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_UNIFIED_PRODUCT_SHELL_SERIES. Live React frontend navigation panel mounted at frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/UnifiedNavigationPanel.tsx. Renders one tab per surface (Idea Lab, Repo Clinic, Maintenance Bay, Learning Studio, Proof / Operator Center). Reads the locked backend view-model via invokeUnifiedProductCommand('get_unified_product_navigation_model'). For each surface displays: purpose, blocked/unsupported states, what is allowed, what is NOT authorized (with explicit source_mutation_boundary and training_eligibility_boundary text), 'Ready does NOT mean authorized.' caption, claim caveats, and shared 8-class authority vocabulary. Tests assert all required data-testid sections are present, all 5 surface labels render, the missing-surface banner exists, no green/success text without negative-authority caption, no mutating/approval/training command is invoked, and the API lib refuses any backend response claiming source_mutation_authorized=true or training_eligible=true.
